plugin.name: Tencent Hunyuan
plugin.description: Tencent Hunyuan's models for the agent, with your own API key.
plugin.longDescription: Adds Tencent Hunyuan to Settings → Providers. Enter your API key here or in Settings and its models appear in the model menu; the list is read from Tencent Hunyuan, so new models show up by themselves.
config.apiKey.title: Tencent Hunyuan API key
config.apiKey.description: From the Tencent Cloud console → Hunyuan → API Key.
